purpose: OFFLINE HISTORICAL MODEL ONLY. No deployment or connected trading functions. Examine one partial risk-reduction exit while preserving MR40 natural exit for remaining holdings.
definitions: Only after a fully closed 4-hour candle falls below the initial filled entry price by threshold, reduce that historical simulated position once at subsequent candle open. Remaining units continue unchanged until existing Z>=0 close condition. A complete natural exit takes precedence. No intrabar execution; historical fees/slippage modeled. No additions/reentries/leverage. Respect minimum 0.00001 BTC and 1 USDT venue conditions.
criteria: Train profit: normal PnL >= base, stress PnL >= base*1.05 and worst close DD <= base*1.10. Train efficiency: normal CAGR >= base*.75, stress CAGR positive, DD <= base*.90 and score=min(normal,stress CAGR)/max(normal,stress DD) >= base*1.10. Frozen evaluation success for selected: both normal/stress profits >= base*.75, close DD <= base*.80, efficiency >= base*1.10. If none train-qualify, retain baseline. Do not retune.
validation: Pinned old input hashes and baseline exact parity, independent accounting replay, time-prefix invariance, case-specific synthetic tests. All prior data already seen.
permissions: Research files only; do not interact with active Paper or Live environments.
